requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Merged security, encryption, audit, compliance, HIPAA compliance, API endpoint security, patient authentication with MFA, session management, and log sanitization requirements.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Merged uptime, latency, throughput, performance, system uptime SLA, planned maintenance, and performance optimization requirements.

requirements.title: Data Architecture
requirements.description: Design and implement a scalable data architecture, including data models for patients, providers, and appointments.

requirements.title: Cloud-Native Deployment
requirements.description: Deploy the system on a cloud-native platform, ensuring scalability and compliance.

requirements.title: Patient Care Management
requirements.description: Manage patient information, including registration, profiles, medical history, appointment scheduling, clinical note management, and medical record management.

requirements.title: Telehealth and Remote Monitoring
requirements.description: Provide telehealth consultations, remote monitoring dashboard, and emergency symptoms alert.

requirements.title: Interoperability and Integration
requirements.description: Integrate with EHR systems using HL7 FHIR standards, insurance eligibility verification, and other relevant integrations.

requirements.title: Patient Engagement
requirements.description: Engage patients through a virtual waiting room, automated alerts, and document upload capabilities.

requirements.title: Prescription Refill Workflow
requirements.description: Manage prescription refills, including patient-initiated refills and pharmacy notifications.

requirements.title: Insurance Claim and Billing Workflow
requirements.description: Manage insurance claims and billing, including EDI submissions and remittance advice processing.

requirements.title: Accessibility Compliance
requirements.description: Portal must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA.

requirements.title: Role-Based Access Control
requirements.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) with 4 roles: Patient, Provider, Staff, Admin.

requirements.title: Data Backup and Recovery
requirements.description: Azure SQL point-in-time restore with 35-day retention.

requirements.title: SMART on FHIR Authorization
requirements.description: Implement SMART on FHIR authorization for secure access to patient data by third-party applications.

requirements.title: Medication Management
requirements.description: Manage patient medications, including medication lists, history, and formulary checks.

requirements.title: Telehealth Consultation Execution
requirements.description: Conducting telehealth consultations through the portal.

requirements.title: Inventory Management
requirements.description: No direct requirement, removed from consideration as it was not part of the original list.

requirements.title: Patient Portal
requirements.description: Encompasses patient profile, calendar view, appointment booking, remote monitoring dashboard, lab results viewer, registration form, telehealth video visit, prescriptions tab, and patient dashboard.

requirements.title: Scheduling and Consultation Workflows
requirements.description: Includes online booking with real-time availability checking, video consultation workflow, and virtual triage workflow.

requirements.title: Waitlist Functionality
requirements.description: Waitlist functionality to fill cancelled slots automatically.
